item.title: Foundation donates $325K for symbolic walkway repairs at Flight 93 memorial site
item.description: SHANKSVILLE, Pa. (WTAJ) -- A Pittsburgh foundation has donated funding to assist with repairs to the "flight path" walkway at the Flight 93 National Memorial. According to our media partners at The Tribune-Democrat, The Henry L. Hillman Foundation contributed $325,000 to repair the walkway that symbolizes the final flight path of United Airlines Flight 93.
